summary: ACNB Corp filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, disclosing that its subsidiary ACNB Bank will rebrand the Traditions Bank and Traditions Mortgage divisions it acquired via the 2025 Traditions Bancorp purchase. The change, effective in the first quarter of 2027, renames Traditions Bank to ACNB Bank in York County, PA, and Traditions Mortgage to ACNB Mortgage across all markets. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or mechanics are stated. This is an operational branding integration update, not a special situation; watch for customer attrition and integration execution risk.
